subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers require live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof before this external PR can merge, or explicitly override that proof gate?
rationale: The source path looks correct, but external PR policy requires real behavior proof and the posted evidence is mocked manager-level tests rather than a live Gateway/provider run.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search.

options.title: Override with deterministic proof
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the proof gate if they decide the MemoryIndexManager regression test is enough for this internal provider path.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or linked artifact showing Gateway memory_search fallback during a primary outage, primary recovery, and a successful after-recovery search.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has direct history around the memory provider-state helper boundary that this proof decision extends.
